name: synthetic-fleet
description: A fictional Garrison installation for benchmarking: placement and scheduling probes on two worker lanes, the end-to-end run flow on the fake harness, a load workload, and a generated fleet of agents, deployments, and shared templates for manifest apply at scale.

corpora.description: Placement and scheduling: node selectors on worker lanes, weight 0 deployments, runs no worker can take (blocked reasons), a missing executable, request validation, priority order, and the per-deployment concurrency limit. Needs two worker lanes (alpha and beta).

Summarize the deployment plan for the staging cluster in one sentence.
Grüße aus Zürich, こんにちは, and a check mark ✓ survive the round trip.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

Line one.
Line two.
	Indented line three.
Quotes " and backslashes \ and {{braces}} and <tags> & ampersands.
Codex format output is parsed into a result.
Mux format output is parsed into a result.
Plain text output becomes the result.
The harness answers with a fixed text.
Return the answer as JSON.
Return the answer as JSON; the first attempt is wrong.
Return the answer as JSON; both attempts are wrong.
This harness reports failure.
This harness overruns its three second deadline by a wide margin, so the worker must stop it.
A long run that is cancelled while it streams output to the worker.
Created twice with one idempotency key.
A run another tenant must not see.
No such agent.
Streaming probe one: output arrives in sixteen character chunks fifty milliseconds apart.
Streaming probe two: the event stream must deliver every chunk in order with no gaps.
Created with wait=true instead of invoke.
